snippet.title: Factory Balls GO! trailer
snippet.description:
I'm excited to introduce my next game... Factory Balls GO!
That's right, the classic Factory Balls puzzle game is back with fresh ideas!
And this time, the balls might even have arms and legs, hence the 'GO!'.
Coming to mobile and PC on April 21st.
You can pre-register right now to jump in on release day:
Apple App store: https://apps.apple.com/app/factory-balls-go/id6759607863
Google Play store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.bartbonte.factoryballsgo
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4460470/Factory_Balls_Go/
On mobile the game will be free and ad-supported. On PC, it will be a premium experience.
